No console errors during normal usage beyond the EXPECTED 401s on /auth/me before login and after logout (acceptable noise per the request).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 code-quality fixes verified safe (no regressions). Auth is now cookie-only via httpOnly access_token, no localStorage at all — confirmed via page.evaluate('localStorage.getItem(auth_token)') returning null both immediately after login and after a hard reload. The 401s seen in DevTools network/console at app boot (before login) and right after Sign out are EXPECTED — AuthContext.refreshMe pings /api/auth/me and treats 401 as 'guest'. If next iteration tightens production cookies (Secure, SameSite=None for cross-site embeds, etc.), retest the reload-persistence path. Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md so future testing agents do not look for localStorage tokens.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. The two highest-risk changes (localStorage removal + env-driven creds) both pass: (a) httpOnly cookie alone keeps the session alive across reloads because the preview URL is same-origin to /api, and axios api client uses withCredentials:true. (b) test_iteration2.py reads ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env when env vars aren't present, restoring the previous 17/17 pass.
